history.summary: A fairly-priced 2BR in a top-developer, highly liquid leasehold development right next to Bartley MRT. At $2,052 psf it undercuts current comparable listings ($2,110-$2,300 psf) and sits within the 2026 transacted band, so entry risk is low. Returns are solid-but-unspectacular: ~3.2% yield plus ~4.5% appreciation. The call hinges on confirming the unit's floor/facing given known PIE/road noise.
history.rating_rationale: (1) Priced below current comps ($2,052 vs $2,110-$2,300 psf) and at/under 2026 transacted avg ($2,176 psf) - you're not overpaying. (2) UOL build quality (Smeg, Keramag, marble/oak) and 797 units = deep liquidity and reliable resale in the D19 upgrader catchment. (3) 3-min walk to Bartley MRT (Circle Line) is genuine, realised transit value. (4) ~87yr lease is healthy. Held back from Strong Buy by a mediocre ~3.2% yield, modest forward appreciation with no fresh catalyst, and an unverified stack/facing that could expose the unit to expressway/road noise.
red_flags: PIE + Upper Paya Lebar Road noise — road-facing stacks are documented as noisy; this listing does not disclose facing/floor
Rental yield only ~3.2% gross — below the 4% bar for a property at this price
Future-potential is thin — Circle Line already running, no new MRT or government transformation zone nearby
Appreciation has cooled post-2023; boom-era CAGR will not necessarily repeat
catalysts: Direct 3-min walk to Bartley MRT (Circle Line) — strong, durable demand anchor for resale and rental
D19 / Bartley is a deep HDB-upgrader market keeping the $1.4-1.6M band liquid
UOL reputation + 797-unit scale supports price floor in a soft market
Priced below current listings — immediate margin of safety on entry

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: 2BR units rent ~$5.6 psf/mo (URA, last 12mo), implying ~$4,000/mo for 721 sqft and ~3.2% gross yield. MRT-adjacency keeps tenant demand steady, but yield is average for the segment and rents have normalised from the 2022-2023 peak. Fine for a buy-and-hold, not a yield play.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Project rose from ~$1,250 psf (2015) to ~$1,915 psf (2024) and ~$2,176 psf (2026 YTD) — strong historically, but driven by the post-COVID boom now past. Forward base case ~4.5%/yr: supported by location/liquidity but capped by the absence of any new catalyst and a mature, fully-priced Circle Line. Upside to ~5% if the broader RCR-adjacent market re-accelerates.
agent_evaluation.stack_notes: Botanique is 9 x 17-storey blocks ~70m apart, with 70%+ of units enjoying pool/landscape views. Target: higher-floor, internal pool/landscape-facing stacks away from Upper Paya Lebar Road and the PIE — quieter, better light, easier to rent/resell. AVOID low-floor stacks fronting the road/expressway (noise complaints are documented). This listing does not state floor/stack/facing — get the unit number and check the site plan before offering; it materially changes the value.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: Agent forward estimate from URA/EdgeProp/Squarefoot transaction history (2015-2026), discounted for cooled momentum and no new catalyst
